steps.content: 09:20 Square Boulevard, third line of defense of FAC
The heavy-armored soldier 036 gives a wave of his hand. Several FAC soldiers raise their guns and start firing on you without reservation. All the bullets hit the ground near you.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: The f**k! Do they really want ${PlayerName} dead?
The bullets lodged in the ground start glowing blue. And you see the Sinners' bodies turn rigid for a second.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Don't worry. It's a short-lasting anti-Mania mechanism, used specifically against Corruptors. We can handle it.
At this moment, the soldier clad in the huge white armor comes hurtling in your direction. He is leading the charge; his great speed and tremendous force leave everyone dumbfounded.
From his trench coat he produces a handful of discs. He uses his power to turn the discs into bombs, which he throws at the incoming enemies.
The wave of explosions is keeping some of the soldiers at bay. But their leader shows no sign of hesitation, speeding up in your direction amid the blast.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: Tsk... too close to use more powerful bombs. That guy's really...

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: Be careful! He's no ordinary man!

Nightmare dashes forward and knocks the white-armored soldier off balance. His left arm seems to have been dislocated, but he shows no intention of backing down. Once he regains his footing, he swings the ax with one hand to suppress Nightmare.
More FAC soldiers are charging from behind him!
